en.title: Bot Reach Coordinates
en.description:
From (x,y) you can only move to (x+y,y) or (x,x+y). Determine whether the target can be reached from the start.

This site's standard input/output protocol and the supplementary limits noted in the statement are this site's judging conventions; they do not imply that the original OA platform provided the same protocol.
en.input: A single line with four positive integers sx sy tx ty, the start and target coordinates; this site adds 1≤sx,sy,tx,ty≤1000000000.
en.output: Output Yes if the target is reachable, otherwise output No.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, the proof of correctness, and the complexity.
hints: Start by identifying the invariants, the boundaries, and the conditions in the rules that must hold at the same time.
